newsitem.title: BOSNIA: NATO seizes four Serb armoured vehicles.
newsitem.headline: NATO seizes four Serb armoured vehicles.

text.p: U.S. soldiers from the NATO-led peace force in Bosnia seized four air defence vehicles from the Serbs on Wednesday after intercepting them as they travelled in convoy, a NATO statement issued in Tuzla said.
The four pieces of equipment were identified as BOV-3's -- small, wheeled air defence vehicles, each carrying three turret-mounted 20mm canons.
A total of 1,500 rounds of ammuntion for the 12 guns was seized as well. All of the equipment is believed to have been stored illegally in a warehouse in the Han Pijesak area.
The vehicles were intercepted during an unauthorised convoy journey to an undetermined site in Sokolac.
Under the terms of the Dayton peace agreement all weapons, military vehicles and soldiers are supposed to be confined to barracks and cantonment sites in Bosnia.
Dayton gives NATO the right to confiscate and destroy military equipment which it found violating the peace agreement's provisions.
